answers.why do you want to work at: Example Robotics builds autonomous systems where software decisions meet physical constraints, which is the kind of problem I enjoy most. I want to learn how production robotics teams test reliability before code reaches real machines. My coursework in distributed systems and machine learning has prepared me to contribute quickly, and I am excited to grow alongside engineers who care about safety and careful measurement.
answers.technical project: I built a small simulation service that replays recorded sensor logs to test a path planner offline. It runs replays in parallel, compares each result with a known baseline, and flags regressions before a merge. The hardest part was making results deterministic across machines. After I fixed random seeds and timing dependencies, the test suite became trusted, and our team caught planning bugs much earlier.
